capabilities: Manages tasks as Markdown checklist files in TodoData/
Schedules recurring tasks with local-calendar due dates
Reorders tasks, subtasks and lists via drag-and-drop board views
Binds tasks to dedicated linked notes with two-way title sync
Backs up lists with daily snapshots and JSON archive export
extras: Metadata is embedded as JSON in HTML comments on each checklist line; interface is bilingual English/Simplified Chinese; requires Obsidian 1.8.7+; architecture details live in ARCHITECTURE.md.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated task manager with scheduling, recurrence, priority sorting, board views and per-task notes built on plain vault files.
summary: Three-pane, local-first task manager storing tasks as Markdown checklists with recurrence, boards, subtasks, attachments and backups.
